module rtlpp_00674 (
  in1,
  in2,
  sum,
  cout
);
  input in1;
  input in2;
  output sum;
  output cout;

  wire gnd = 1'b0;
  wire vcc = 1'b1;

  wire sum_wire;
  wire cout_wire;

  // Internal input buffers
  wire in1_internal;
  wire in2_internal;

  assign in1_internal = in1;
  assign in2_internal = in2;

  // Logic for sum and carry out
  assign sum_wire = in1_internal ^ in2_internal;
  assign cout_wire = in1_internal & in2_internal;

  // Output assignment
  assign sum = sum_wire;
  assign cout = cout_wire;

endmodule
